functions.name: approve_remediation
functions.description: Record a human decision about one proposed instruction. The approver is read from the caller's token, never passed in.

functions.name: submit_feedback
functions.description: Record what a person thinks of an answer. Evidence for triage, never an approval.

functions.name: list_pending_remediations
functions.description: What is waiting for a decision.

functions.name: list_similar_pending
functions.description: Which other questions are waiting on the same proposed sentence as this one. Read only.

functions.name: approve_similar
functions.description: Record the same decision for every question carrying the same proposed sentence. Approved rows are marked as covered by the approval that carries the change, so nothing is applied twice.
